create_simple_vit_model: create a SimpleViT model for image classification with query-key normalization and sincos positional embeddings
build_attention_with_qk_norm: build an Attention module that applies RMSNorm to queries and keys before computing attention scores
build_transformer_blocks: build a Transformer with stacked Attention and FeedForward layers using pre-norm residual connections
create_rmsnorm_layer: create an RMSNorm layer that normalizes attention queries and keys without mean-centering
generate_sincos_positional_embedding: generate 2D sinusoidal positional embeddings for patch-grid dimensions with configurable temperature
